links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy and appropriateness of recommended examinations and treatment versus expert decisions
links.effect: ChatGPT-4 diagnosed 82% correctly vs Llama2 76%; appropriate tests 88% vs 83%; appropriate treatment 80% vs 72%; both sometimes suggested inappropriate tests.
links.quote: Sometimes, both systems suggested inappropriate tests.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the diagnostic, examination, and treatment decision-making performance of ChatGPT-4 and Llama2 on 98 clinical otolaryngology case vignettes evaluated offline by clinicians, but does not compare or test a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
